title: ** Austin 1882: Fire Department Funding & Sewer Plans
summary:
• **Fire Department Budget:** Council debated a $346/month appropriation for fire department expenses (April-October 1882) and a separate $3,000 allocation for hydrants and water pipes, though some votes on these measures failed to pass.

• **Underground Sewer Project:** A petition from citizens was referred to a special committee to decide whether to allow W.B. Brush to construct and maintain an underground sewer system in Austin.

• **Saloon License Approved:** A.Raggio & Co. received permission to open a saloon on Pecan Street in the Second Ward.

• **Fire Safety Rules:** The Fire Commissioners announced they would begin enforcing all fire safety ordinances going forward, and approved a small storage shed behind the Capitol building for fire tools.

• **Building Modifications:** The council granted one property owner permission to keep rear stairs as a fire escape (if replaced with iron stairs within a year) but denied another building owner's request for rear alley stairs.
